SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)
FROM crossing_points c
GLOBAL JOIN islands i ON i.id = 45
WHERE c.h3 GLOBAL IN (SELECT arrayJoin(h3CoverRing(arrayElement(geom.Polygon, 1), 4146)) FROM islands WHERE id = 45 AND variantType(geom) = 'Polygon' UNION ALL SELECT arrayJoin(h3CoverLine(geom.LineString, 4146)) FROM islands WHERE id = 45 AND variantType(geom) = 'LineString')
  AND polygonsDistanceCartesian(
        array(array(tuple(c.x, c.y))),
        multiIf(
          variantType(i.geom) = 'Polygon',
            arrayMap(ring -> arrayMap(pt -> tuple(6378137. * radians(pt.1), 6378137. * log(tan(pi() / 4 + radians(pt.2) / 2))), ring), i.geom.Polygon),
          variantType(i.geom) = 'LineString',
            array(arrayMap(pt -> tuple(6378137. * radians(pt.1), 6378137. * log(tan(pi() / 4 + radians(pt.2) / 2))), i.geom.LineString)),
          array(array(tuple(0.0, 0.0)))
        )
      ) <= 4146
  AND c.timestamp BETWEEN '2024-06-24 05:53:53' AND '2024-07-01 23:33:49'
  AND c.id > 0 AND c.id < 1000000000000

SELECT toDate(day) AS day, count() AS unique_crossings
FROM crossings_summary s
ARRAY JOIN arrayMap(i -> toStartOfDay(toDateTime('2025-04-07 12:58:49', 'UTC')) + toIntervalDay(i),
                    range(toUInt32(dateDiff('day', toStartOfDay(toDateTime('2025-04-07 12:58:49', 'UTC')), toDateTime('2025-04-21 05:14:04', 'UTC')) + 1))) AS day
WHERE s.id > 0 AND s.id < 1000000000000
  AND s.start_time <= toDateTime('2025-04-21 05:14:04', 'UTC') AND s.end_time >= toDateTime('2025-04-07 12:58:49', 'UTC')
  AND s.start_time < day + toIntervalDay(1) AND s.end_time >= day
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY unique_crossings DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH p AS (SELECT EPOCHRANGE '[2025-04-07 12:58:49, 2025-04-21 05:14:04]' AS r)
SELECT TO_CHAR(d.day::ts, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS unique_crossings
FROM crossings c
STRAIGHT JOIN (
  SELECT
    (TS_DAYSTART(p.r[0]) + TP '1d' *  s.num)      ::epoch AS day,
    (TS_DAYSTART(p.r[0]) + TP '1d' * (s.num + 1)) ::epoch AS next_day
FROM p, const.sequence(0, 9) s
WHERE (TS_DAYSTART(p.r[0]) + TP '1d' *  s.num)      ::epoch < p.r[1]
  AND (TS_DAYSTART(p.r[0]) + TP '1d' * (s.num + 1)) ::epoch > p.r[0]
) d ON c.t && RANGE(d.day, d.next_day)
WHERE c.t && EPOCHRANGE '[2025-04-07 12:58:49, 2025-04-21 05:14:04]'
GROUP BY d.day
ORDER BY unique_crossings DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT
    GREATEST(c.t[0], (EPOCHRANGE '[2024-05-16 03:48:07, 2024-05-24 00:50:45]')[0]) AS lo,
    LEAST   (c.t[1], (EPOCHRANGE '[2024-05-16 03:48:07, 2024-05-24 00:50:45]')[1]) AS hi
  FROM crossings c
  WHERE c.t && EPOCHRANGE '[2024-05-16 03:48:07, 2024-05-24 00:50:45]'
) w
WHERE hi - lo >= TP '24h'
  OR ( TS_TIMEOFDAY(lo) <  TP '1h' * (18 + 1)
